entries.title: New indictment alleges Nick Reiner was lying in wait before killing his parents
entries.summary: A grand jury has indicted Nick Reiner on murder charges in the killings of his parents, Rob Reiner and Michele Singer Reiner, and adds the allegation that he was lying in wait before attacking them.

entries.title: Millions crowd cities to see Spain's first total solar eclipse in over a century
entries.summary: As the sky darkened, gradually at first and then quickly, people broke into applause and cheered. It was the Spain's first total solar eclipse in more than a century.

entries.title: 3 men set for lethal injection on same day in Tennessee, Alabama and Oklahoma
entries.summary: Three men in Tennessee, Alabama and Oklahoma are scheduled for lethal injection Thursday in a rare convergence of executions on the same day in the U.S.

entries.title: Photos: See the best photos from the solar eclipse
entries.summary: Millions of people in Europe stepped outside this evening to watch a spectacular sunset with a solar eclipse. The path of totality passed through portions of Greenland, Iceland and Spain,

entries.title: ICE plans to outfit officers with electric shock gloves
entries.summary: The company that makes the gloves, Compliant Technologies, says they're a nonlethal tool to make individuals compliant during arrests.

entries.title: Trump sued over service selling faster access to Truth Social posts
entries.summary: The federal lawsuit alleges that the service from the president's media company violates the Constitution. Meanwhile, Trump Media executives say they have signed up more than 10 customers.

entries.title: Controversial group wins $158M-contract to represent unaccompanied immigrant children
entries.summary: Utah-based Our Rescue was founded by activist Tim Ballard. It was previously known as Operation Underground Railroad and it says it helps law enforcement perform sting operations and rescues human trafficking survivors.

entries.title: White House press secretary leaving
entries.summary: Karoline Leavitt will continue to be an outside adviser, Trump said

entries.title: Has the U.S. lost its dominance to China?
entries.summary: Beijing may be benefiting from the war in Iran and Trump's tariffs and has an edge in the competition for tech supremacy. The New Yorker's Evan Osnos discusses his story "The Future, Made in China."

entries.title: Inflation eases in July as gasoline and grocery prices fall
entries.summary: Consumer prices in July were up 3.4% from a year ago — a smaller annual increase than in May or June. The news makes it less likely the Fed will feel the need to raise interest rates in September.
